what: Nothing is left out of the GitHub repo without asking Love first
words: literally nothing of remote significance is to be discarded. whether you deem it significant or not. ask me whether something should be added to the repository before making an executive decision on whether it matters or whether it should be included or not. ask. 100% of the time pls

proof.process: list any file not going in and ask Love; only node_modules and .secrets stay out (Love: "6 & 7 no"). The desk's own .gitignore says tools/ - when syncing, the repo's .gitignore is rewritten so tools/ always goes in
